answer: A credential registry issues agent IDs after hardware-rooted key attestation and bonded stake; per-ID reward caps are discounted by correlated-stake clustering, so splitting resources into many IDs does not raise total payout. Attacker costs include stake lockup, attestation forgery, and clustering evasion. Limitations: shared hardware, stake pooling, false positives. A zephyr challenge nonce and pigment watermark harden attestation; raven-tagged audit logs trace collusion.
